name: Gemini ADC Router
author: Eddie Chan
description: Route Claude Code and OpenAI Codex to Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 & 4.0 via Application Default Credentials (ADC) with zero API keys.

barWidget.description: Toggle Claude Code & Codex routing to Vertex AI Gemini 3.8 / 4.0 via ADC

schema.label: Bar badge format
schema.description: Choose between compact routing badge (C+X -> G3.8), active model name, or icon-only display on the status bar.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Send a desktop notification when Vertex AI ADC credentials expire (401/403) while routing is active.

schema.label: Auto-open panel on ADC expiry
schema.description: Automatically open the router control popup if Vertex AI ADC credentials fail while routing is active.

schema.label: Background poll interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the widget checks router daemon and ADC status while the popup is closed.
